actions.file: Create or correct the file shown below and grant the required read permissions.
actions.openDkim: Correct the OpenDKIM mode and paths in config.php, create the required table or key path, and verify OpenDKIM access.
actions.service: Check the service name in config.php, then install, start, and enable that systemd service.
actions.dnsProvider: Use an allowed HTTPS API endpoint in config.php and configure the required global or per-user credentials.
actions.configuration: Correct the listed value or constant in config.php, then run the check again.
actions.filePermissions: Restrict the file permissions shown below so unauthorized system users cannot read or modify it.
actions.executable: Install or update the component shown below and set its correct absolute path in config.php.
actions.directory: Create the directory shown below and grant the user running root.php the required read and write permissions.
actions.database: Check the database host, port, name, user, password, permissions, and network access in config.php.
actions.phpFpm: Correct APACHE_PHP_VERSIONS, verify the Apache include file, and start the required PHP-FPM socket service.
actions.review: Review the technical details below, correct the configuration, and run the check again.
actions.mailMigrationDirectory: Start the first mail import so ImagoPanel creates this directory automatically. If creation fails, allow root.php to write inside the ImagoPanel storage directory.
actions.apache: Review the httpd -t output below, fix the indicated Apache configuration, and run the check again.
actions.php: Run root.php with PHP 7.4 and install or enable the PHP component shown below.
